title: Basin Metamorphosis in Coupled Phase Oscillators
summary: We investigate the global basin structure of twisted states in nearest-neighbor coupled phase oscillators with a common phase shift $α$. As $α$ increases, basin boundaries become progressively more complex, with their fractal dimension growing toward that of the full ambient phase space. We conjecture that the basins eventually become riddled-like as the system approaches the limit $α\to \fracπ{2}$, where the dynamics becomes volume-preserving.
